Perks › Malus

Stumble

Malus · Turn penalty

After scoring, you must draw on your next turn whenever possible.

In-game card text

How it works

Malus. After any play that scores for you, your next turn must start with a boneyard draw. After that draw you may play as normal.

  • Once the boneyard is empty the requirement lifts and you play normally.
  • You can't use Catch and Release on this draw.
  • Malus Ward can block it.
  • Extra copies change nothing.

At a glance
